caveats: Fewer than 10 resume events in at least one condition. The distributions are reported; the comparison is not, because it would not mean anything yet.
Single subject, single machine: this is a case study, not a trial.
The operator can see which condition they are in. A tool you can look at cannot be blinded, and this confound does not shrink with sample size.
Resume events are inferred from attention gaps, not self-reported. A gap is a proxy for an interruption and will miscount an unattended machine.
